## Skeletons and animation in the Model Maker
- New **Skeleton** mode (4): add bones, extrude chains, or drop in a **Humanoid** skeleton fitted to your model. Symmetrize copies left bones to the right.
- Skin follows the bones automatically; **Weight paint** (P) fixes spots that bend wrong.
- New **Pose** mode (5) with a timeline: pose bones, press **I** to keyframe, Space to play. Ready-made Walk, Run, Idle, Wave and Jump clips for humanoids.
- Saved models keep their bones and clips, and the **Animator** component plays them in your game.
- Claude can build rigged, animated models too. Get the updated extension from the repo: `extension/Ignite3D.mcpb`.
